subject: Tailored SLA exhibit and evidence request for HelixPath deployment
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: procurement@helixpath.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Tailored SLA exhibit & evidence for HelixPath deployment

Hi Nina / HelixPath procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. As discussed, we're ready to propose a tailored SLA exhibit to attach to the Enterprise Order Form for your pilot (dedicated capacity). To keep things moving, we need a couple of clarifications from your side and are proposing draft language for a few items below.

What we need from you to finalize:
- Your preferred availability target (we recommended 99.95% for dedicated pools; please confirm).
- Any mandatory exclusions (maintenance windows, force majeure specifics, regulatory blackout periods).
- Procurement questionnaire / compliance pack (SOC / pen-test summary) — if you can send that, we'll attach our evidence.
- Confirmation on whether service credit caps should be a percentage of monthly recurring charges or a flat cap.

Proposed Redwood deliverables:
- Draft SLA exhibit (we'll send a redline for your review).
- Evidence pack: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), uptime sample reporting, measurement methodology, and 12 months of audit retention.
- Order form language: explicit callout to Dedicated Deployment, model pin/version, and data residency region.

Attachments I will prepare and send once we get your questionnaire:
- Redwood_SLA_Exhibit_redline.docx (initial redline)
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf (redacted)
- uptime-sample-report-2027Q1.csv (sample measurement)

Timeline proposal: we can turn around a redline within 48 hours of receiving your procurement questionnaire and SOC/pen-test materials. If that works, we'll also include a DocuSign envelope link for the Order Form addendum so your legal can route it.

Next steps: please send the procurement questionnaire and any specific credit/penalty math you require. If helpful, Marcus and Laura from our ops and legal liaisons are cc'ed and can jump in.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0126

Attachments referenced: (stubs) Redwood_SLA_Exhibit_redline.docx (draft), Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf (redacted), uptime-sample-report-2027Q1.csv (sample)

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@helixpath.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Tailored SLA exhibit & evidence for HelixPath deployment

Hi Avery —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick items from procurement / security: we will want to review a redacted SOC 2 Type II and a recent pen-test summary. Please also include a short note on how you measure uptime (sources, aggregation window, and any reconciliation process).

On availability: our internal target to support our clinical customers is 99.97% during business hours with a 99.9% 24x7 baseline. We recognize some of those targets may require specific architecture or deployment commitments — we are open to tradeoffs on cost vs. uptime.

Service credits: we'd prefer a percentage-of-monthly-recurring-fee model, with an initial cap of 10% but willing to negotiate. Can you confirm Redwood's standard cap and whether you allow per-incident escalations above the cap with executive remediation plans?

Attached: HelixPath_Computing_Q_2027.pdf (procurement questionnaire) — this contains our required audit items and some onboarding dates.

If you can send a redline that maps proposed credit calculations and measurement examples, we can route to our legal and SRE for a quick review.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Head of Procurement | HelixPath Medical
nina.patel@helixpath.com

Attachment: HelixPath_Computing_Q_2027.pdf (procurement questionnaire)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: Tailored SLA exhibit & evidence for HelixPath deployment

Avery — quick internal note on proposed language and constraints: 

1) Availability target: for Dedicated pools we can support 99.95% monthly uptime SLA by default. 99.97% is achievable but requires pinned hardware + cross-region failover and will materially increase cost. Recommend we present both options with explicit cost delta in the order form.

2) Measurement and evidence: we measure at the per-customer ingress/egress gateway and calculate availability using 1-minute buckets, rolling 30-day windows, with reconciliation logs retained for 12 months. We'll include a sample CSV and a short runbook to explain the measurement.

3) Service credits: legal prefers a monthly cap at 5% of MRC for Hosted/Dedicated by default. For enterprise deals we can escalate to 10% with exec remediation and a custom SOW clause; this must be approved by Legal.

4) Exclusions: scheduled maintenance (48-72 hour notice for major upgrades), customer-caused outages, third-party provider outages (IaaS), and force majeure. We can add a narrow carve-out for regulatory-mandated downtime.

I'll draft a redline with the two availability tiers, sample calculations, and an evidence appendix. Can Laura review for procurement/legal hooks and then we send to Nina. If we need Legal sign-off on the credit cap or exec-remediation clause, we should loop them in now.

Marcus
Director, Product Ops | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@helixpath.com>, procurement@helixpath.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: Tailored SLA exhibit & evidence for HelixPath deployment

Hi Nina —

Appreciate the quick reply and the attached questionnaire. Per Marcus and Laura's input, we've prepared an initial redline that includes two availability options and sample credit math. Summary below and attached:

- Option A (Standard): 99.95% monthly uptime for Dedicated Deployment. Standard credit cap: 5% MRC.
- Option B (Enhanced): 99.97% monthly uptime with cross-region failover. Estimated cost uplift: +18% MRC. Credit cap: 10% MRC with an executive remediation clause.

Measurement & evidence: we attach a sample uptime report (uptime-sample-report-2027Q1.csv) and a short measurement methodology appendix. Evidence retention: 12 months.

Attachments included (stubs):
- HelixPath_SLA_Redline_v1.docx (redline exhibits for Order Form)
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf (redacted statement)
- uptime-sample-report-2027Q1.csv (measurement example)

Next steps:
1) Please review the redline and indicate whether you prefer Option A or Option B.
2) If you choose Option B, we'll need approval of the cost uplift and a short SOW for cross-region capacity.
3) Legal/Procurement: once you confirm, we'll issue a DocuSign envelope for the Order Form addendum (link below) and can incorporate any redlines you send back.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC123-HELIXPATH
HubSpot deal: deal/HP-2027-0142

If it helps, Marcus and Laura can jump on a 30-minute call with your SRE and procurement to walk through measurement and credit calculation examples.

Best regards,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0126
